about: Every quote change and trade the v9 bot saw in its 10 live rounds against three figgie.com Hard bots (polled every 200 ms, so a quote replaced within one poll can be missed). Seats are 0-3; 'me' is the bot's. Each log entry is k,at,suit,price,who,p_goal,took separated by ';': k is b (bid), o (offer) or t (trade); at is seconds left on the 240-second clock; suit is 0-3 for spades, clubs, hearts, diamonds; who is the quoting seat, or buyer>seller for a trade; on the bot's own trades p_goal is its P(goal) per suit just before the trade and took is T if it crossed the spread, F if a resting quote of its own was filled.
